name: API Authentication
description: Production APIs must use approved authentication.
rule: API authentication must be OAuth2/OIDC or an approved enterprise mechanism.

name: Secrets Management
description: Application secrets must use approved secret management.
rule: Production APIs must use Azure Key Vault or an approved secret store.

name: PII Classification
description: PII must be classified as Confidential.

name: PII Data Residency
description: PII residency must be explicitly declared.
rule: PII assets cannot have unknown residency.

name: Integration Standard
description: Enterprise integrations must use approved protocols.
rule: HTTPS, REST, ServiceBus and EventGrid are approved in this demo.

name: Messaging Resilience
description: Messaging workloads require retry and DLQ controls.
rule: Messaging components must define retryPolicy and deadLetterQueue.

name: Technology Catalog
description: Production workloads should use approved technologies.
rule: Component technologies must be in the approved catalog.

name: AI Data Boundary
description: AI workloads must use an approved data boundary.
rule: AI components handling enterprise data require an approved AI boundary.

name: AI PII Handling
description: PII must not be sent to AI without explicit controls.
rule: PII + AI requires redaction or an approved PII-allowed boundary.
